TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced
TABLE.COMMENT: Instance settings for each Group self-selection (Advanced) activity

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Point value of the activity

FIELD.NAME: minsize
FIELD.COMMENT: L1: minimum confirmed members per group, leader included

FIELD.NAME: maxsize
FIELD.COMMENT: L2: maximum members per group counting confirmed plus pending invitations

FIELD.NAME: maxlead
FIELD.COMMENT: L3: maximum groups a student may lead in this activity

FIELD.NAME: maxmembership
FIELD.COMMENT: L4: maximum groups a student may belong to (led plus joined)

FIELD.NAME: maxguided
FIELD.COMMENT: L5: default maximum groups per guide

FIELD.NAME: uidprefix
FIELD.COMMENT: Prefix of every group's plugin id; applies to groups created after a change

FIELD.NAME: uiddigits
FIELD.COMMENT: Digits in the number part of every group's plugin id; applies to groups created after a change

FIELD.NAME: studentapproach
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: guides never advertise availability - no volunteering, no listing, no load figures; students approach a guide by submitting

FIELD.NAME: uidformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Project id template using {prefix}, {course} and {number}; empty means the default shape

FIELD.NAME: timeopen
FIELD.COMMENT: Formation window opens (0 = not set)

FIELD.NAME: timedue
FIELD.COMMENT: Penalty-free deadline (0 = not set)

FIELD.NAME: timecutoff
FIELD.COMMENT: Hard stop (0 = not set)

FIELD.NAME: penaltytype
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = percent of grade per day late, 1 = points per day late

FIELD.NAME: penaltyperday
FIELD.COMMENT: Penalty per day late between timedue and timecutoff

FIELD.NAME: guidemode
FIELD.COMMENT: Guide selection mode: 0 = leader selects, 1 = manager assigns

FIELD.NAME: inviteexpiry
FIELD.COMMENT: Invitation expiry in days, 0 = never

FIELD.NAME: autogroup
FIELD.COMMENT: Auto-grouping of groupless students enabled

FIELD.NAME: proposalrequired
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 optional, 1 proposal upload mandatory before submission

FIELD.NAME: guidewindow
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds a guide has to decide after submission; 0 = unlimited

FIELD.NAME: guideautoapprove
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: groups undecided past the window auto-approve

FIELD.NAME: guidevolunteer
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: guides must volunteer a capacity to become available for new assignments

FIELD.NAME: eoienabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: leaders may list teams and guides may express interest

FIELD.NAME: eoiwindow
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds a leader has to respond to an interest; 0 = never expires

FIELD.NAME: eoimax
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum open interests one guide may hold in this activity

FIELD.NAME: eoisequential
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: leader sees only the earliest pending interest until it is decided

FIELD.NAME: eoipeers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: guides can see which other guides are interested in a group

FIELD.NAME: eoigroupmax
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum pending guide interests one group may hold; 0 = unlimited

FIELD.NAME: minmembership
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum groups each student must belong to; below = defaulter

FIELD.NAME: defaulterpenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Mark penalty per missing membership

FIELD.NAME: incompletepenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Mark penalty when a group is below its minimum size

FIELD.NAME: leadershare
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent of the incomplete penalty the leader carries

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_group
TABLE.COMMENT: Plugin-side proposed groups, distinct from Moodle core groups until frozen

FIELD.NAME: activityid
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity instance this group belongs to

FIELD.NAME: pluginuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin-scoped unique human-readable group ID, e.g. SSA-PHYS101-0042

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Group name, unique within the activity, fixed by the creating student

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Title of work

FIELD.NAME: brief
FIELD.COMMENT: Brief of work (rich text)

FIELD.NAME: leaderid
FIELD.COMMENT: Current leader (also has a confirmed member row with isleader = 1)

FIELD.NAME: guideid
FIELD.COMMENT: Assigned guide; cleared when the guide returns the group

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: forming, pending_guide, firm or frozen

FIELD.NAME: autoformed
FIELD.COMMENT: Created by the auto-grouping engine

FIELD.NAME: successorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Active succession nominee, if any

FIELD.NAME: successortype
FIELD.COMMENT: transfer or stepout

FIELD.NAME: guidesuccessorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Guide-handover nominee awaiting acceptance, if any

FIELD.NAME: timeguidenominated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the guide handover was proposed

FIELD.NAME: returncomment
FIELD.COMMENT: Latest guide return comment; history lives in events

FIELD.NAME: returncommentformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Text format of returncomment; legacy rows are plain text

FIELD.NAME: listed
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: the leader listed this forming team for guide interest

FIELD.NAME: timelisted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the team was first listed

FIELD.NAME: guidenotes
FIELD.COMMENT: Guide private rich-text notes taken before accepting

FIELD.NAME: timeapproved
FIELD.COMMENT: Drives the penalty ledger

FIELD.NAME: coregroupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mirrored Moodle core group id while frozen; ownership tracking

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_member
TABLE.COMMENT: Group membership and invitations; one row per group and user

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: invited, confirmed, declined, expired or removed

FIELD.NAME: leaverequested
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of a pending leave request awaiting leader confirmation

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_userattr
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-wide participant attributes held for this plugin only; never read from or written to profile fields

FIELD.NAME: mobile
FIELD.COMMENT: Contact number; shown only to holders of the viewall capability

FIELD.NAME: seatlocation
FIELD.COMMENT: faculty seat / office location shown to students

FIELD.NAME: program
FIELD.COMMENT: Type of programme (e.g. BTech, MSc); vocabulary-backed

FIELD.NAME: shareconsent
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: the student consented to share their mobile with leaders and teammates

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_quota
TABLE.COMMENT: Composition quota rules per activity, with explicit priority order

FIELD.NAME: dimension
FIELD.COMMENT: gender, department or subdepartment

FIELD.NAME: rtype
FIELD.COMMENT: value rule (value, min, max) or distinct rule (at least k distinct values)

FIELD.NAME: value
FIELD.COMMENT: Attribute value for value rules; null for distinct rules

FIELD.NAME: mincount
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum members (value rules) or minimum distinct values (distinct rules)

FIELD.NAME: maxcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum members; null for no maximum

FIELD.NAME: priority
FIELD.COMMENT: Rule priority; uniqueness per activity enforced by the store to allow safe reordering

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_override
TABLE.COMMENT: Override rows resolved exclusively through the override resolution service

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: user, group, guide or move

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Target user for user and guide scopes

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Target group for group scope

FIELD.NAME: moveid
FIELD.COMMENT: Target staged move for move scope

FIELD.NAME: maxlead
FIELD.COMMENT: L3 override, user scope

FIELD.NAME: maxmembership
FIELD.COMMENT: L4 override, user scope

FIELD.NAME: maxguided
FIELD.COMMENT: L5 override, guide scope

FIELD.NAME: minsize
FIELD.COMMENT: L1 override, group scope

FIELD.NAME: maxsize
FIELD.COMMENT: L2 override, group scope

FIELD.NAME: quotaexempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Group scope quota exemption

FIELD.NAME: penaltywaived
FIELD.COMMENT: Group scope penalty waiver

FIELD.NAME: guidehidden
FIELD.COMMENT: Guide scope: 1 hides this user from every guide picker

FIELD.NAME: rulesbypassed
FIELD.COMMENT: Move scope: comma-separated rule codes bypassed for that move

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active or pending (guarded reduction awaiting blocker clearance)

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_move
TABLE.COMMENT: Staged manager moves, committed atomically only when every rule passes or is overridden

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Student being moved

FIELD.NAME: sourcegroupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Null when placing a groupless student

FIELD.NAME: makeleader
FIELD.COMMENT: Designate the moved student leader of the target group

FIELD.NAME: replaceleader
FIELD.COMMENT: explicit consent to demote the target group leader

FIELD.NAME: successorid
FIELD.COMMENT: New leader for the source group when moving its leader out

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, committed or cancelled

FIELD.NAME: statusinfo
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON per-rule validation results for the manager UI

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_snapshot
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only roster snapshots taken at freeze time and refreshed by staged moves on frozen groups

FIELD.NAME: coregroupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Mirrored core group at snapshot time

FIELD.NAME: roster
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of userid and isleader entries

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_penalty
TABLE.COMMENT: Authoritative per-group penalty ledger; one current row per group

FIELD.NAME: dayslate
FIELD.COMMENT: Days between effective timedue and timeapproved, bounded by effective timecutoff

FIELD.NAME: penaltyvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Resolved points deduction

FIELD.NAME: award
FIELD.COMMENT: Guide-awarded group mark, null until set

FIELD.NAME: waivereason
FIELD.COMMENT: dateoverride or waiver

FIELD.NAME: basis
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON audit record: effective dates, rate, type and arithmetic

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_agrun
TABLE.COMMENT: Auto-grouping run records: seed, summary and full decision log

FIELD.NAME: seed
FIELD.COMMENT: Deterministic replay seed

FIELD.NAME: triggeredby
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 for the scheduled task, else the manager userid

FIELD.NAME: log
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON decision trail including every rule relaxation

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_dept
TABLE.COMMENT: Pre-defined department/sub-department vocabulary, course-category format (parent/depth/path/sortorder), site-wide

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: dept or program vocabulary entry

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_template
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-activity notification template overrides, editable via the manage capability

FIELD.NAME: msgkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Body lang key of the message kind

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_qslot
TABLE.COMMENT: Slot-based composition template: ordered slots each demanding mincount members matching a dimension value or distinct values; members are booked to one slot only

FIELD.NAME: matchtype
FIELD.COMMENT: value: all match value; distinct: pairwise different values

FIELD.NAME: allowoverlap
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: values already used by earlier slots stay eligible

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_volunteer
TABLE.COMMENT: Guide-declared capacity: how many groups a guide has volunteered to take on, consulted by the resolver when guide volunteering is enabled

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The guide declaring capacity

FIELD.NAME: capacity
FIELD.COMMENT: Groups volunteered for; 0 means withdrawn

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_digestq
TABLE.COMMENT: Guide-facing notifications queued for a recipient's daily or weekly digest instead of being sent immediately

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Recipient awaiting the digest

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: Related group, when the notification concerns one; null otherwise

FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: Message provider name from db/messages.php

FIELD.NAME: subjectkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Lang key for the subject

FIELD.NAME: bodykey
FIELD.COMMENT: Lang key for the body

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the already-resolved $a placeholder object

FIELD.NAME: contexturl
FIELD.COMMENT: Deep link target

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_eoi
TABLE.COMMENT: Guide expressions of interest in listed teams: pending until the leader decides, with full history kept

FIELD.NAME: guideid
FIELD.COMMENT: The interested guide

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, accepted, rejected, expired or withdrawn

FIELD.NAME: remarks
FIELD.COMMENT: Rich-text remarks the guide attached when expressing interest

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: First come, first served ordering

TABLE.NAME: selfselectadvanced_ticket
TABLE.COMMENT: Sequential request queue: guide composition-change and unfreeze requests, claimed exclusively by one manager or coordinator at a time

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: compchange or unfreeze

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: open, claimed, resolved, declined or withdrawn

FIELD.NAME: request
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the change is needed, from the requester

FIELD.NAME: claimedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The one manager or coordinator working this ticket

FIELD.NAME: resolution
FIELD.COMMENT: What the claimant did, or why it was declined
